lines.text: The day the world ended... I was making coffee.
lines.style: First-person survivor remembering the day it began. Low, gravelly and haunted, but keep it moving: one short beat after 'ended', no other pauses.

lines.text: Emergency alert. Stay indoors. Lock your doors. Do not let *anyone* in.
lines.style: Urgent emergency-broadcast news anchor reading an official alert. Clipped, tense, fast, authoritative.

lines.text: Then I saw Mr. Dawson across the street.
lines.style: Quiet and uneasy, conversational pace, no pauses.
Unsettled. A short beat after 'walking', then 'wrong' with a chill. Keep it tight.

lines.text: He looked up. Right at me.
lines.style: Dread, nearly whispered, then a sharp catch of breath on 'right at me'.
Terrified and breathless, fast short phrases with no long gaps, each 'again' louder and more desperate.
Barely a whisper. A long held pause after 'then'.

lines.text: That's when I realised... it was *never* just him.
lines.style: Quiet dawning horror at a steady pace. A brief beat after 'realised', then the final words land firm. Do not drag.

music.title: Last Light - Day One
music.style: Dark cinematic horror underscore for a zombie short film. Opens eerie and quiet: low drones, distant ticking, a lonely detuned piano note. Slowly builds dread with pulsing sub bass and dissonant strings, rising to a frantic, pounding climax in the final third, then a sudden menacing stinger. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
